Subject: Q3 Executive HC slate — governance notes & sign-off

Team —

Attached is the Q3 executive headcount slate (Q3_exec_slate_v3.xlsx) for review and sign-off. This is the consolidated list following org-level planning: 6 senior hires (VP+/GM-level) across Product, Infrastructure, and Enterprise GTM. Key asks in this email: 

- Please review the compensation band calls in column F and any deviations flagged in column H.
- Confirm delegation exceptions (column K) where hiring managers will be allowed to extend offers up to the mid-point.
- If there are political/board sensitivities for any role, flag them in the "notes" tab and copy the board secretariat.

Timeline: I need final leadership sign-off by EOD Friday so People can trigger external searches and start offer approvals next week.

Notes / high-level context:
- We retained the previously agreed total HC cap for Q3; these are redistributions of a small executive buffer (3 FTEs reallocated).
- Compensation exceptions are expected for at most two hires and must be accompanied by a short rationale.

Attachments: Q3_exec_slate_v3.xlsx, HC_delegation_matrix.pdf

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
SVP, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

Jonas — thanks for the clear deck. Quick inline on the spreadsheet: I added a comment on row 14 (Head of Cloud Infrastructure) suggesting a top-of-band offer authority for a narrow set of extenuating circumstances (market counter, critical delivery need). I've attached a one-pager with proposed guardrails (HC_delegation_matrix_comments.xlsx).

I also propose we treat the Enterprise GTM GM role (row 9) as a "board notice" role rather than board approval — we signal to the board secretariat but allow People to proceed with an offer up to 110% of midpoint with Marcus' approval. Rationale: tight revenue timelines, prior relationship with candidate.

If folks are comfortable with those constraints, I can update the sheet and we can move to sign-off.

—Aditya

Thanks all for the quick reviews. I approve the Q3 executive slate with the following directed constraints (please ensure before any offer is extended):

1) Cloud Infrastructure head: permitted up to top-of-band (per Aditya's note) only after People confirms expedited references and documented business case (Laura).
2) Enterprise GTM GM: board notice only; offers may proceed up to 110% midpoint with Marcus' written concurrence (Marcus, please confirm by COB Monday).
3) No other delegation exceptions beyond the two noted; any additional exceptions require a CEO approval email.

Jonas / Laura — please record this thread as formal sign-off in the hiring folder and notify Legal & Finance of the exceptions so we have the audit trail. Sarah — please align TalentPartners to prioritize the Cloud Infrastructure search as discussed.

Approved,
Vivek Kulkarni
CEO, Redwood Inference
